title: Add ability score entry and allocation UX
description:
Add ability score modeling and CLI interaction for both concept-first and ability-first character creation.

Design direction
- Point buy should be the default score method in concept-first mode if point buy is already supported.
- Ability-first mode should support generating or entering scores before class selection.
- The draft should record the score source/method instead of treating all scores as equivalent.
- Point-buy validation must be immediate and actionable.

Supported methods should be modeled even if implementation is staged:
- point buy;
- standard array;
- manual entry;
- rolled/imported scores.

Acceptance criteria
- User can edit one score at a time and see remaining point-buy budget.
- Point-buy scores outside 8-15 before ancestry bonuses are rejected immediately.
- Non-integer scores produce field-specific errors.
- Ability-first mode can collect scores before class and later use them for class recommendations.
- Tests cover point-buy bounds, non-integer input, recomputation of modifiers, and preservation of existing draft state.
notes: Implemented in PR #290 (branch eshyra-b69j.7); awaiting review/merge. Adds abilityAllocation.ts (point-buy budget, pool assignment, rolling, recommendations, command parser), manual/rolled AbilityScoreMethod, resolver.listClasses().
